claim: Gartner's survey of 632 B2B buyers found that most prefer to research independently through digital channels, supporting investment in a useful self-service website.
quote: A survey of 632 B2B buyers conducted in August through September 2024 found most buyers prefer to carry out independent research through digital channels.
title: Gartner Sales Survey Finds 61% of B2B Buyers Prefer a Rep-Free Buying Experience

claim: Gartner reported in March 2026 that 67% of B2B buyers preferred a rep-free experience, reinforcing the value of clear online information before sales contact.
quote: Buyers want to engage on their own terms as 67% of B2B buyers state that they prefer a rep‑free experience, according to a survey by Gartner, Inc., a business and technology insights company.
title: Gartner Sales Survey Finds 67% of B2B Buyers Prefer a Rep-Free Experience

claim: TrustRadius's 2024 technology-buyer research places user reviews among the three most-consulted resources, supporting prominent, authentic customer proof.
quote: User reviews continue to rank among the top three resources consulted by technology buyers
title: 2024 B2B Buying Disconnect Report: The Year of the Brand Crisis

claim: TrustRadius found that 77% of surveyed software buyers read user reviews during their buying journey, supporting accessible, authentic customer testimony on vendor websites.
quote: 77% of buyers reported reading user reviews during their buying journey.
title: Bridging the Trust Gap: B2B Tech Buying in the Age of AI

claim: TrustRadius found that 54% of buyers spoke with a user before purchasing, indicating that peer experience is an important source of purchase confidence.
quote: While 54% of buyers report having a conversation with a user before purchasing a product, vendors believe this number is much lower, at 38%.
title: Bridging the Trust Gap: B2B Tech Buying in the Age of AI

claim: Case studies should complement rather than replace independent proof, because TrustRadius found that buyers placed them low among consulted resources despite their popularity with vendors.
quote: Case studies continue to be the top tactic, even though buyers consistently place them low on the list of consulted resources.
title: 2024 B2B Buying Disconnect Report: The Year of the Brand Crisis

claim: The 2024 Edelman–LinkedIn research found that 75% of decision-makers and C-suite executives had researched a previously unconsidered product or service after encountering thought leadership.
quote: 75% of decision-makers and C-suite execs say that a particular piece of thought leadership has led them to research a product or service they were not previously considering.
title: Reach Beyond The Ready: B2B Thought Leadership Research From LinkedIn and Edelman

claim: In the 2024 Edelman–LinkedIn study, 73% of decision-makers considered thought leadership a more trustworthy basis for assessing a supplier’s capabilities than marketing materials and product sheets.
quote: Nearly three-fourths of decision-makers (73%) say that an organization’s thought leadership content is a more trustworthy basis for assessing its capabilities and competencies than its marketing materials and product sheets.
title: Why B2B Thought Leadership Matters and How to Get It Right

claim: NN/g's usability research shows that auto-rotating panels can prevent users from finding even prominent offers, supporting static or user-controlled hero content.
quote: The user's target was at the top of the page in 98-point font. But she failed to find it because the panel auto-rotated instead of staying still.
title: Auto-Forwarding Carousels and Accordions Annoy Users and Reduce Visibility

claim: For deep site structures, mega menus can save users time by allowing them to skip intermediate navigation levels.
quote: If typical user journeys involve drilling down through several levels, mega menus can save users time by letting them skip a level (or two).
title: Menu-Design Checklist: 17 UX Guidelines

claim: Consistent navigation and familiar interaction patterns reduce relearning and confusion, helping visitors focus on the website’s content and services.
quote: To be easy to learn and use, systems should adhere to both internal and external consistency — they should use the same patterns everywhere inside the system and should also follow web-, platform-, and domain-specific conventions.
title: Maintain Consistency and Adhere to Standards (Usability Heuristic #4)

claim: Stanford's credibility research supports professional, purpose-appropriate visual design and consistent layout, typography and imagery because people rapidly judge sites by appearance.
quote: We find that people quickly evaluate a site by visual design alone. When designing your site, pay attention to layout, typography, images, consistency issues, and more.
title: Stanford Guidelines for Web Credibility
publisher: Stanford Persuasive Technology Lab, Stanford University

claim: Attractive interfaces can increase perceived usability, although visual polish does not remedy serious usability problems.
quote: The aesthetic-usability effect refers to users’ tendency to perceive attractive products as more usable. People tend to believe that things that look better will work better — even if they aren’t actually more effective or efficient.
title: The Aesthetic-Usability Effect

claim: Specific CTA and link labels help visitors predict their destination, whereas vague or repeated labels make navigation harder.
quote: Vague or repetitive links make it difficult for users to anticipate what these links lead to. That’s bad for users, but it’s also bad for companies, who usually want to entice users to learn more about their features or services.
title: Better Link Labels: 4Ss for Encouraging Clicks

claim: HubSpot reported that personalised CTAs converted 202% better than basic CTAs in its analysis of more than 330,000 CTAs, a contextual benchmark rather than a guaranteed uplift from wording alone.
quote: After analyzing and comparing more than 330,000 CTAs over a six-month timeframe, we discovered that personalized CTAs convert 202% better than basic CTAs.
title: 15 Call-to-Action Statistics You Need to Know About to Increase Your Conversion Rate

claim: Google warns that intrusive pop-ups can obstruct content, erode trust and contribute to poor search performance, supporting less disruptive promotional treatments.
quote: Intrusive dialogs and interstitials make it hard for Google and other search engines to understand your content, which may lead to poor search performance.
title: Avoid intrusive interstitials and dialogs

claim: Google recommends small banners instead of full-page promotional interstitials so that users and search engines can reach the content immediately.
quote: Instead of full page interstitials, use banners that take up only a small fraction of the screen to grab your users' attention. Banners ensure that users and search engines can get to the content as soon as they land on the page.
title: Avoid intrusive interstitials and dialogs

claim: Google exempts legally mandatory interstitials from its interstitial guidance, so necessary consent interfaces should not be confused with intrusive promotional pop-ups.
quote: Mandatory interstitials are exempted from the guidelines discussed in this document; however, if possible, we recommend that sites follow these best practices:
title: Avoid intrusive interstitials and dialogs

claim: Google’s original mobile-search policy states that pages whose content is not easily accessible after a search-result click may rank less highly, rather than imposing a blanket ban on all pop-ups.
quote: To improve the mobile search experience, after January 10, 2017, pages where content is not easily accessible to a user on the transition from the mobile search results may not rank as highly.
title: Helping users easily access content on mobile

claim: Vodafone's controlled landing-page test found that a 31% improvement in Largest Contentful Paint produced 8% more sales and a 15% improvement in lead-to-visit rate, demonstrating a measurable business benefit from faster rendering.
quote: By running an A/B test specifically focused on optimizing Web Vitals, Vodafone found that a 31% improvement in LCP led to 8% more sales, a 15% improvement in their lead to visit rate, and a 11% improvement in their cart to visit rate.
title: Vodafone: A 31% improvement in LCP increased sales by 8%

claim: The Google-commissioned Deloitte study associated a 0.1-second improvement in mobile site speed with an 8.3% improvement in bounce rate on lead-generation information pages.
quote: Lead generation information pages bounce rate improved by 8.3%
title: Milliseconds Make Millions

claim: For a domain or URL migration, Google recommends server-side permanent redirects such as HTTP 301 or 308 from each old URL to its corresponding new destination.
quote: Although Googlebot supports several kinds of redirects, we recommend that you use HTTP permanent redirects if possible, such as 301 and 308.
title: How to move a site

claim: Google advises giving each new URL a self-referencing canonical tag to help search engines recognise the intended destination after a migration.
quote: Each new URL should have a self-referencing rel="canonical" <link> tag.
title: How to move a site

claim: When changing domains or subdomains, Google instructs site owners to submit a Change of Address in Search Console for the old site.
quote: If you're changing domain names or subdomains, submit a Change of Address in Search Console for the old site.
title: How to move a site

claim: Google recommends keeping migration redirects for at least a year so that signals and links can be transferred to the new URLs.
quote: Keep the redirects for as long as possible, generally at least 1 year. This timeframe allows Google to transfer all signals to the new URLs, including recrawling and reassigning links on other sites that point to your old URLs.
title: How to move a site

claim: Canonicalisation can consolidate search signals for duplicate or similar pages into one preferred URL, but canonical declarations are signals rather than guarantees.
quote: It helps search engines to be able to consolidate the signals they have for the individual URLs (such as links to them) into a single, preferred URL.
title: How to specify a canonical URL with rel="canonical" and other methods

claim: WCAG 2.2 was first published as a W3C Recommendation on 5 October 2023.
quote: W3C Recommendation 05 October 2023
title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2

claim: The current published WCAG 2.2 Recommendation is dated 12 December 2024.
quote: W3C Recommendation 12 December 2024
title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2

claim: Following WCAG 2.2 makes enterprise website content accessible to more people with disabilities and often improves usability for visitors generally.
quote: Following these guidelines will make content more accessible to a wider range of people with disabilities, including accommodations for blindness and low vision, deafness and hearing loss, limited movement, speech disabilities, photosensitivity, and combinations of these, and some accommodation for learning disabilities and cognitive limitations; but will not address every user need for people with these disabilities. These guidelines address accessibility of web content on any kind of device (including desktops, laptops, kiosks, and mobile devices). Following these guidelines will also often make web content more usable to users in general.
title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2

claim: Michalsons advises that using cookies for direct marketing to a person who is not already a customer requires that person's consent under POPIA.
quote: If a responsible party uses cookies for the purpose of direct marketing and the data subject is not a customer of the responsible party, the responsible party must get the data subject’s consent.
title: Cookie law in South Africa | Guidance and actions

claim: Under POPIA, electronic direct marketing requires consent unless the recipient qualifies for the conditional existing-customer exception, so enquiry submission should not automatically enrol prospects in marketing.
quote:
The processing of personal information of a data subject for the purpose of direct marketing by means of any form of electronic communication, including automatic calling machines, facsimile machines, SMSs or e-mail is prohibited unless the data subject —
(a) has given his, her or its consent to the processing; or
(b) is, subject to subsection (3), a customer of the responsible party
title: Guidance Note on Direct Marketing in terms of the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA)

claim: POPIA direct-marketing communications must identify the sender and provide contact details through which recipients can ask for marketing to stop.
quote:
Any communication for the purpose of direct marketing must contain—
(a) details of the identity of the sender or the person on whose behalf the communication has been sent; and
(b) an address or other contact details to which the recipient may send a request that such communications cease
title: Guidance Note on Direct Marketing in terms of the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA)

claim: Where GDPR consent is relied upon, pre-ticked boxes, silence and merely continuing to use a service do not constitute valid active consent.
quote: The use of pre-ticked opt-in boxes is invalid under the GDPR. Silence or inactivity on the part of the data subject, as well as merely proceeding with a service cannot be regarded as an active indication of choice.
title: Guidelines 05/2020 on consent under Regulation 2016/679

claim: RFC 9116 defines security.txt to make vulnerability reporting easier by publishing an organisation's disclosure practices in a machine-readable format.
quote: This document defines a machine-parsable format ("security.txt") to help organizations describe their vulnerability disclosure practices to make it easier for researchers to report vulnerabilities.
title: RFC 9116: A File Format to Aid in Security Vulnerability Disclosure
publisher: Internet Engineering Task Force / RFC Editor

claim: A security.txt file must include a Contact field specifying how researchers should report vulnerabilities.
quote: The "Contact" field indicates a method that researchers should use for reporting security vulnerabilities such as an email address, a phone number, and/or a web page with contact information. This field MUST always be present in a "security.txt" file.
title: RFC 9116: A File Format to Aid in Security Vulnerability Disclosure
publisher: Internet Engineering Task Force / RFC Editor

claim: RFC 9116 requires web-based services to publish security.txt under /.well-known/ so that vulnerability researchers can find it consistently.
quote: For web-based services, organizations MUST place the "security.txt" file under the "/.well-known/" path
title: RFC 9116: A File Format to Aid in Security Vulnerability Disclosure
publisher: Internet Engineering Task Force / RFC Editor

claim: Africa Tech Festival's official listing gives the 2026 expo and content-session dates as 17–19 November at the Cape Town International Convention Centre, with VIP and partner events beginning on 16 November.
quote:
Expo & Content Sessions: 17 - 19 Nov 2026
VIP & Partner Events: 16 -19 Nov 2026
Cape Town International Convention Centre, Cape Town
title: Linkfields

claim: The official Africa Tech Festival site identifies Informa as the event brand behind the festival.
quote: Brought to you by Informa
title: Linkfields

claim: The official 2026 Africa Tech Festival profile gives Linkfields’s stand number as I74, beginning with the capital letter I rather than the digit 1.
title: Linkfields

claim: CEIR research reports that 90% of exhibition attendees pre-plan and 64% search for booths to visit, supporting a discoverable event page and meeting-booking option before the show.
quote: CEIR research has documented that most attendees, 90%, pre-plan. A show website is an important resource, and exhibitors likely experience engagement that flows from attendee interaction on a website. CEIR research has documented that when pre-planning, 64% of attendees conduct searches to identify exhibit booths to visit.
title: New CEIR Report Outlines Digital Tactics, Show Services and DIY Marketing Effectiveness for Exhibitor Success
publisher: Trade Show Executive, quoting CEIR Vice President of Research Nancy Drapeau

claim: Africa Tech Festival’s 2026 ATF Connect service offers pre-arranged meetings with an audience defined by the participating organisation, making meeting-booking a concrete event opportunity rather than a generic CTA.
quote: You set the criteria. Define your audience and we'll secure meetings with the right decision makers that matter to you.
title: ATF Connect — Pre-Arranged, High-Value 1:1 Meetings

claim: The official 2026 sponsor directory lists Linkfields under Platinum Sponsors.
quote:
Platinum Sponsors

Linkfields
title: 2026 Sponsors & Exhibitors
